mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the pulling threads was most worthwhile because the result connects the cell parts to muscle action and shows how sliding filaments shorten a unit.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making and then fitting the nuclei felt a little repetitive; the first result showed their structure but gave little explanation of their role.

surprise.text: I was interested that the filaments stay the same length while their increased overlap shortens the unit.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless: the goals and named slots made the choices understandable, although the compatible options guided me rather than requiring me to discover the pairings.
